nodes.label: Write transaction · commit
nodes.detail:
Business change + terminal outcome +
outbox fact commit together. Receipt
carries store, epoch and opaque
version.

nodes.label:
Delivery · position 2
arrives first
nodes.detail:
Position 1 is missing. Complete
applied prefix stays 0. A larger
received position proves no
visibility.

nodes.label:
Projection · position 1 then
2
nodes.detail:
Apply exact facts in order. Update
read content and contiguous prefix
atomically. Repeated delivery is
deduplicated.

nodes.label: Read at least the receipt
nodes.detail:
Check current reader authorization
first: denied readers receive no
content. A receipt grants no access.
Authorized freshness is visible only
for the matching store/epoch and
qualified content through the complete
prefix; otherwise pending or
unsupported.

nodes.label: Restore boundary
nodes.detail:
Rotate visibility epoch and fence
uncertain restored state. Epoch
rotation does not erase old replay
identity or authorize retry.

omissions: This is a concept-map presentation of the original tutorial panels. Original storyboard-specific positions, swimlanes, sequence lifelines, state glyphs and timeline geometry are not reproduced. All authored panel text remains visible and in the source companion.

panels.title: Write transaction · commit
panels.text: Business change + terminal outcome + outbox fact commit together. Receipt carries store, epoch and opaque version.

panels.title: Delivery · position 2 arrives first
panels.text: Position 1 is missing. Complete applied prefix stays 0. A larger received position proves no visibility.

panels.title: Projection · position 1 then 2
panels.text: Apply exact facts in order. Update read content and contiguous prefix atomically. Repeated delivery is deduplicated.

panels.title: Read at least the receipt
panels.text: Check current reader authorization first: denied readers receive no content. A receipt grants no access. Authorized freshness is visible only for the matching store/epoch and qualified content through the complete prefix; otherwise pending or unsupported.

panels.title: Restore boundary
panels.text: Rotate visibility epoch and fence uncertain restored state. Epoch rotation does not erase old replay identity or authorize retry.
